verdict.rationale: Gitea's marketing page lists 'SAML SSO Integration' as a feature, so the product itself claims SAML SSO. Nothing documents the ability to require or enforce SAML for an organization. The community mentions of OIDC and OAuth2 are adjacent protocols and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented organization-level enforcement of SAML SSO, configuration docs for SAML setup, which edition or tier includes it, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can require SAML single sign-on for my organization
